project: Early-Stage Ransomware Detection via Dynamic Memory Analysis and Reinforcement Learning
description: Formal specification for temporal and memory telemetry observations capturing progressive execution windows.
status: Schema validation and pipeline specification (synthetic demo data only)

identification_fields.name: sample_id
identification_fields.description: Unique session UUID for the sample execution run

identification_fields.name: parent_process_id
identification_fields.description: Parent process ID (PPID) in the process execution tree

identification_fields.name: process_name
identification_fields.description: Name of the executing binary image

identification_fields.name: label
identification_fields.description: Binary ground-truth classification label (benign or ransomware)

identification_fields.name: family
identification_fields.description: Specific malware family (e.g., G, E, L) or benign baseline

temporal_ordering_fields.name: timestamp_us
temporal_ordering_fields.description: Microsecond epoch timestamp of observation window close

temporal_ordering_fields.name: relative_time_ms
temporal_ordering_fields.description: Elapsed execution time in milliseconds from process start

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: api_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: Total API invocations in current window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: api_rate
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: API calls per millisecond in current window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: dll_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: Count of newly loaded DLL modules in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: dll_load_rate
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: DLL loads per second in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: registry_read_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: Registry key query and open count in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: registry_write_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: Registry value modifications and key creations in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: file_read_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: File system read operations in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: file_write_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: File system write/modify operations in window

behavioral_telemetry_fields.name: directory_activity_count
behavioral_telemetry_fields.description: Directory enumeration and walk operations in window

memory_telemetry_fields.name: entropy
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Average Shannon entropy of written buffers and volatile memory pages

memory_telemetry_fields.name: memory_snapshot_id
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Unique identifier for associated volatile memory snapshot

memory_telemetry_fields.name: working_set_bytes
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Current process physical working set size in bytes

memory_telemetry_fields.name: private_bytes
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Committed private virtual memory allocation in bytes

memory_telemetry_fields.name: handle_count
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Total open kernel object handles (files, keys, mutexes)

memory_telemetry_fields.name: thread_count
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Number of active threads executing in process

memory_telemetry_fields.name: network_connection_count
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Active TCP/UDP sockets associated with process ID

memory_telemetry_fields.name: loaded_module_count
memory_telemetry_fields.description: Total count of DLL modules mapped into process address space

pipeline_constraints.causality: All rolling statistics and deltas must only consume observations at or before current time step t (strictly no lookahead).
pipeline_constraints.splitting: Splits must be grouped strictly by sample_id so all observation windows of a sample belong to the same partition.
pipeline_constraints.normalization: Scaler parameters must be fitted solely on training samples and never on test samples.
